intent: Ferry crossings over a swimmable, bramble-seeded lake: board at the jetty, time the open-water storm lanes from cover, and never miss the last boat. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The first lake jetty
sections.lesson: Board at the jetty · time the open-water storm from the far shore. Follow the weight as it swings away.

signs.text:
The first lake jetty
Follow the weight as it swings away.

sections.name: The storm shelter

sections.name: The last evening boat
